steps.title: Accounts & access
steps.goal: Every third-party account the build needs exists under one founder email with 2FA on, before any agent needs a key: GitHub (repo default branch main, Actions on, Claude connector with write access), Supabase (organization on the Free plan, no project yet), Vercel (team `Anacast` with the Vercel GitHub App installed for ChurchAppCLD and no project imported yet; on Pro now, or on Hobby with a recorded to-do to upgrade before step 2.5), Stripe (test mode), plus Expo, a Google account for Firebase and the Google Play Console developer account (all may be deferred to step 4.5), the Apple Developer Program (deferred to step 6.4) and optionally a domain and a Resend account. The Anacast identity values the code depends on are already decided and only checked here, never re-asked: display name `Anacast`, Android package id `com.anacast.app` (confirmed 2026-09-07), deep-link scheme `anacast`, the five-blue brand palette with its token roles confirmed 2026-09-08, and the decision that there is no production domain yet (the Vercel URL serves until the features work). The founder's own computer has Git, Node 22, pnpm 10 and a clone of the repository so the terminal commands of later checklists (`openssl`, `npx eas-cli`, `adb`) have a place to run, and the founder has decided how `docs/TODO.md` reaches the agents (merge its branch into `main`, or name the branch at the start of every session). A password-manager vault exists so no secret ever lands in git, a prompt, or chat, and HANDOFF.md carries a per-account status line.
steps.founder_checklist:
## 0.1 — Accounts & access (founder, about 90 minutes including the computer set-up in item 12, no code)

Use one email for everything below (`<FOUNDER_EMAIL>`) and turn on two-factor authentication on every account (each block below says where the switch is) — these accounts will hold church members' personal data.

1. **GitHub — repository `RadioDinner/ChurchAppCLD` (already exists).**
   1. github.com → `RadioDinner/ChurchAppCLD` → Settings → General → "Default branch" = `main` (change it if it still points at a `claude/...` branch).
   2. Settings → Branches: no protection rule on `main` (agents push to `main` directly — standing order 6).
   3. Settings → Actions → General → "Allow all actions and reusable workflows" (step 1.1 adds one non-blocking CI workflow; its final Verify item needs Actions on).
   4. claude.ai → Settings → Connectors → GitHub: confirm the Claude GitHub App has read/write access to `ChurchAppCLD`.
   5. 2FA: github.com → your avatar → Settings → Password and authentication → Two-factor authentication → Enable (authenticator app; save the recovery codes in the vault from item 11).
2. **Supabase account (Free plan).**
   1. supabase.com → "Start your project" → sign in with GitHub or `<FOUNDER_EMAIL>`.
   2. Create an Organization: name `Anacast`, plan **Free** (founder decision 10).
   3. Do **not** create a project yet — step 2.4 creates it (US East) once `supabase/migrations/9999_init.sql` exists. A Free project pauses after 7 idle days; creating it early only burns that window.
   4. 2FA: avatar (bottom-left) → Account Settings → Security → Multi-factor authentication → Add authenticator app.
3. **Vercel account + team.**
   1. vercel.com → "Continue with GitHub" (the GitHub identity that owns `RadioDinner`).
   2. Dashboard → team switcher (top-left) → "Create Team" → name `Anacast`. Plan: **Pro** (US$20 per member per month) — recommended now, per founder decision 10 "Vercel PRO at launch". The one hard rule: the team must be on Pro before step 2.5 imports the project, because the repo ships `apps/web/vercel.json` with a `*/5 * * * *` cron that a Hobby deployment rejects at build time, and Hobby forbids commercial use. If you would rather not pay until the first deployment, create the team on **Hobby** today and write "Vercel: upgrade to Pro (Team Settings → Billing → Upgrade) before step 2.5" into HANDOFF.md → Environment status (item 11 below); step 2.5's precondition checks for Pro.
   3. Install the Vercel GitHub App **without importing a project**: github.com/apps/vercel → Configure → choose the `RadioDinner` account → "Only select repositories" → `ChurchAppCLD` → Save. (Alternative from inside Vercel: Add New… → Project → "Continue with GitHub" → "Adjust GitHub App Permissions" → select `ChurchAppCLD` → Save, then close the dialog — stop before clicking Import.)
   4. Check: Vercel → Add New… → Project → "Import Git Repository" lists `ChurchAppCLD`. Do **not** click Import — step 2.5 imports it with Root Directory `apps/web`.
   5. 2FA: avatar → Account Settings → Authentication → Two-Factor Authentication → Enable.
4. **Stripe account (test mode).**
   1. dashboard.stripe.com/register → `<FOUNDER_EMAIL>` → business name `Anacast` (editable later) → verify the email.
   2. Stay in **Test mode** (toggle top-right / "Sandboxes"). Do not activate live payments until launch; the product, the US$50/month price and the webhook are created in step 3.9.
   3. 2FA: Settings (gear) → Team and security → Your profile → Two-step authentication → Add (authenticator app or SMS; authenticator preferred).
5. **Expo account (needed at step 4.5 — may be created then).** expo.dev/signup → `<FOUNDER_EMAIL>` → username `anacast` (or similar). The free plan is enough for EAS Build (monthly build quota, lower-priority queue). Record the Expo username in HANDOFF.md → Environment status (item 11): step 4.5's `npx eas-cli init` creates the EAS project under that account and step 4.1's `app.config.ts` may set it as `owner`. 2FA: expo.dev → Account settings → Two-factor authentication.
6. **Google account for Firebase and Play (needed at step 4.5 — may be created then).**
   1. Decide which Google account will own the Firebase project (console.firebase.google.com) for push notifications (step 4.5).
   2. The same account should own the **Google Play Console developer account** (play.google.com/console; US$25 one-time). It is not needed for the sideloaded APK of Checkpoint C, but it *is* on the critical path to the store: identity verification takes days, and a personal developer account created after November 2023 must run a **14-day closed test with at least 12 testers** before Google grants production access (steps 6.5 and 6.8). Create and verify it no later than step 4.5, so the clock starts early; record in HANDOFF.md whether it is done or deferred to 4.5.
   3. 2FA: myaccount.google.com → Security → 2-Step Verification.
7. **Apple Developer Program (needed at step 6.4 — deferred).** US$99/year; enrolment for an individual takes about two days, for an organisation longer (a D-U-N-S number is required). Nothing to do now; record "Apple Developer: deferred to 6.4" in HANDOFF.md.
8. **Domain and Resend — not needed for the app URL, needed for e-mail before step 3.9 item 5.**
   1. App URL: you decided on 2026-09-08 that there is **no production domain yet** (orchestrator decision 31a) — the web app lives on Vercel's generated `*.vercel.app` URL until the features work, and `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` (web) and `EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL` (mobile) carry that URL (`<VERCEL_URL>`, recorded by step 2.5). Nothing to decide today. Know the cost of adding a custom domain (`<DOMAIN>`) later: it changes invite/share URLs and the Supabase Auth redirect list (share links already issued keep the old host), means a new privacy-policy/terms URL in both store listings (steps 6.4–6.6) and re-verifying `assetlinks.json`, and — once Android App Links ship in steps 5.7a/5.8 — a new APK, because the host is compiled into the app. So if a custom domain is ever coming, register it before Checkpoint D (step 5.9) at the latest.
   2. E-mail sending needs a **verified sending domain** whatever the app URL is: Supabase's built-in sender is rate-limited and delivers only to addresses that are members of your Supabase organization, so until Supabase custom SMTP runs through Resend (step 3.9 item 5), nobody but you receives OTP codes, confirmations or password resets (3.9 item 6 records the organization-member fallback for the trial). resend.com → account with `<FOUNDER_EMAIL>` (free tier: 3,000 emails/month); verifying a domain you already own is enough — the sending domain need not be the app's domain. Do it now if you own a domain; otherwise record "Resend: deferred to 3.9" and plan to have a domain before 3.9.
9. **Identity values (already decided — check, do not re-decide).**
   1. Android package id: `com.anacast.app` (confirmed 2026-09-07, orchestrator decision 18; immutable after the first Play upload). Check that HANDOFF.md → Decisions lists it; nothing to decide.
   2. Deep-link scheme: `anacast` (orchestrator decision 5). Check that HANDOFF.md → Decisions lists it.
   3. App display name: `Anacast` (given). Same check.
   4. Brand colours: the five-blue palette and its token roles are decided — Prussian Blue `#00072d` = `ink`, Deep Navy `#001c55` = `primaryDark`, Imperial Blue `#0a2472` = `primary`, Bright Marine `#0e6ba8` = `accent`, Icy Blue `#a6e1fa` = `tint`, confirmed by you on 2026-09-08 (orchestrator decision 32b). Check that HANDOFF.md → "Brand palette" third column says "confirmed by the founder 2026-09-08"; nothing to decide.
   5. Production domain: none yet, by your decision of 2026-09-08 (orchestrator decision 31a) — the Vercel URL serves until the features work (item 8.1). Check that HANDOFF.md → "Still open for the founder" records it ("no production domain yet"); nothing to decide.
10. **Password manager.** Create a vault or folder "Anacast — infrastructure" with entries for GitHub, Supabase, Vercel, Stripe, Expo, Google, Apple, registrar/Resend. Every key produced in steps 2.4, 2.5, 3.9 and 4.5 goes there, together with the 2FA recovery codes. Never paste a key into git, into a Claude Code prompt (`prompt_history.txt` is committed verbatim), or into chat.
11. **Record in `HANDOFF.md`.** Under "Environment status" add a first item "0. Accounts (step 0.1)" with one line per account — GitHub, Supabase, Vercel (plan, and "upgrade to Pro before step 2.5" if on Hobby), Stripe, Expo (username), Google/Firebase, Play Console, Apple Developer, domain ("none yet — Vercel URL, decision 31a"), Resend — each "done" or "deferred to step N.N" — plus one line for your computer (item 12) and one for the `docs/TODO.md` branch choice (item 13). Under "Decisions" check that `Anacast` / `com.anacast.app` / `anacast` are listed; add only what is missing. Do **not** edit the "Brand palette" table or the "Still open for the founder" section — both already record your answers of 2026-09-08 (items 9.4 and 9.5 are checks, not decisions). Either edit the file yourself and commit, or paste the helper prompt below into a Claude Code session with your values filled in.
12. **Your computer (needed from step 2.5 on; the agents' machines do not replace it).** Later checklists make you run terminal commands that need a clone of the repository and a few tools: step 2.5 item 1 (`openssl rand -base64 32` for the two app secrets), step 4.5 (`git pull`, `pnpm install`, `npx eas-cli login` / `init` / `build` / `credentials`), step 5.9 (`eas credentials`, `adb shell pm get-app-links`, `curl`) and steps 6.4 / 6.5 / 6.8 (`npx eas-cli build` / `submit`). An agent session on the same machine may run most of them for you, but the Expo, Google and Apple logins are interactive (browser window plus 2FA) and no agent can do them — so the machine must be yours. Set it up now, while nothing is urgent:
   1. Install **Git** (git-scm.com; on Windows it brings Git Bash, which also provides `openssl`; macOS and Linux have `openssl` already) and sign in to GitHub from it (`gh auth login` with the GitHub CLI is the easiest, or HTTPS with a token stored by the credential helper — the token stays in the password manager, never in a prompt).
   2. Install **Node 22** through nvm (`nvm install 22 && nvm use 22`; on Windows use nvm-windows or the Node 22 LTS installer) and **pnpm 10** (`corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@latest-10 --activate`, or `npm install -g pnpm@10`). Check: `node -v` prints `v22.x`, `pnpm -v` prints `10.x`.
   3. Clone the repository into a folder without spaces: `git clone https://github.com/RadioDinner/ChurchAppCLD.git` — every later command that says "at the repo root" runs inside that folder; refresh it with `git pull` before each founder step.
   4. For step 5.9 (may wait until then): **Android platform tools** for `adb` — Android Studio → SDK Manager → SDK Tools → "Android SDK Platform-Tools", or Google's standalone `platform-tools` zip added to your PATH — and USB debugging enabled on the test phone (Settings → About → tap Build number seven times → Developer options → USB debugging). Check: `adb devices` lists the phone.
   5. If you run Claude Code sessions on this machine yourself, install it as claude.ai documents; the standing session rules (`CLAUDE.md`) apply there exactly as on any other machine, including "never type a key, password, token or real email into a prompt".
   6. Record in HANDOFF.md → Environment status item 0: "Founder computer: Git / Node 22 / pnpm 10 / clone ready <date>; adb <ready | at 5.9>".
13. **Where `docs/TODO.md` lives — decide before step 1.1.** This to-do list and its drafting kit were written on branch `claude/project-status-todo-plan-leghlm` and, by your decision of 2026-09-08 (orchestrator decision 32c), are not merged into `main` until you say so. Every agent prompt says "Work on `main` unless I have named another branch in this session" and ends by ticking its checkbox in `docs/TODO.md` — a file that does not exist on `main` until the merge. So pick one:
   1. **Merge** (recommended before step 1.1): open a Claude Code session and paste: "Merge branch `claude/project-status-todo-plan-leghlm` into `main` with a merge commit (no squash, no rebase), push `main`, and record the merge date under HANDOFF.md → Decisions ('TODO.md merged to main <date>')." Afterwards every prompt in this document works as written and you never name a branch.
   2. **Stay on the branch** for now: begin **every** session — including the helper prompt below — with the line "Work on branch `claude/project-status-todo-plan-leghlm` for this session." until you choose option 1. Agents then commit and push to that branch, and `main` stays as it is today.
   Record your choice in HANDOFF.md → Decisions (item 11 / the helper prompt does it for you).
14. **Tick step 0.1 in `docs/TODO.md`** (or let the helper prompt do it) and push, on whichever branch item 13 chose. Then read HANDOFF.md → "Environment status" once more: every account line says done or names the step that needs it.
steps.helper_prompt:
You are working in the ChurchAppCLD repository. CLAUDE.md loads `new_session_instructions.md` and `HANDOFF.md` automatically — follow the session-start checklist (new-session.sh, prompt_history.txt). Work on `main` unless I have named another branch in this session (step 0.1 item 13 explains why I may name `claude/project-status-todo-plan-leghlm`; if `docs/TODO.md` is not on the branch you are on, stop and ask me which branch to use). This is the helper for step 0.1 "Accounts & access" of `docs/TODO.md`; read that step's 'Done when' list first. Read `HANDOFF.md` (Environment status, Decisions, Still open for the founder, Brand palette, Founder answers) and `docs/PLAN.md` §13 before editing. Build ONLY this step; do not start the next one.

## Goal
Record the outcome of my account set-up, my computer set-up and my `docs/TODO.md` branch choice in `HANDOFF.md`, and verify — without changing — the identity values the repo already records. No code; no files other than `HANDOFF.md`, `docs/TODO.md` and the session log.

## Inputs / prior state
- Ask me for any value that is missing instead of guessing; never invent a status.
- Accounts: GitHub done; Supabase organization (Free) done; Vercel team `Anacast` <Pro | Hobby — upgrade to Pro before step 2.5>; Stripe (test mode) done; Expo <username | deferred to 4.5>; Google/Firebase <done | deferred to 4.5>; Play Console <done | deferred to 4.5>; Apple Developer <deferred to 6.4>; domain <`<DOMAIN>` | deferred>; Resend <done | deferred to 3.9>.
- My computer (step 0.1 item 12): Git / Node 22 / pnpm 10 / repo clone <ready <date> | not yet>; adb <ready | at step 5.9>.
- `docs/TODO.md` branch (step 0.1 item 13): <merged into `main` on <date> | staying on `claude/project-status-todo-plan-leghlm` — I name it at the start of every session>.
- Identity values already decided — check only, never ask me to re-decide them: display name `Anacast`, Android package id `com.anacast.app` (confirmed 2026-09-07), deep-link scheme `anacast`, brand palette token roles `primary` Imperial Blue / `primaryDark` Deep Navy / `ink` Prussian Blue / `accent` Bright Marine / `tint` Icy Blue (confirmed 2026-09-08, orchestrator decision 32b), production domain none yet — Vercel URL until the features work (2026-09-08, orchestrator decision 31a).

## Build
1. `HANDOFF.md` → "Environment status": insert a first item "0. Accounts (step 0.1)" listing each account above as done or deferred (with the step that needs it), the Vercel plan (and the "upgrade to Pro before step 2.5" to-do when on Hobby), the Expo username, the domain line "none yet — Vercel URL (decision 31a)", the Resend line, and one line "Founder computer: …" from my inputs. Leave the other numbered items as they are.
2. "Decisions (do not re-open without the founder)": confirm the list already contains display name `Anacast`, package id `com.anacast.app` and deep-link scheme `anacast`; add only what is missing (a missing scheme line reads "Deep-link scheme `anacast` (orchestrator decision 5)"). Add one line recording my `docs/TODO.md` branch choice: "TODO.md merged to `main` <date>" or "TODO.md stays on `claude/project-status-todo-plan-leghlm`; sessions name the branch until the founder says merge". Do not add a domain line: "Still open for the founder" already records "no production domain yet".
3. "Brand palette": verify the five-row table exists and its third column says the token roles were confirmed by the founder on 2026-09-08. Change nothing there; if the column is missing or differs, stop and tell me instead of editing.
4. "Still open for the founder": verify it reads "Nothing" and mentions the domain and the token roles as settled. Change nothing there. In the "Founder answers" table, row 9, replace the "founder to confirm" note with "confirmed `com.anacast.app` 2026-09-07" if it is still there.
5. Update the "_Last updated_" line.

## Constraints
- Do not write any email address, password, key or token into the repo.
- Do not create code, packages, scripts or migrations. Do not edit `new_session_instructions.md`, `docs/PLAN.md` or `docs/DESIGN.md`.
- Do not change any decided value (package id, scheme, display name, palette hex codes and token roles, "no production domain yet"); do not ask me to confirm them again; if I say something that contradicts them, stop and ask.
- Do not merge or rebase any branch in this session; item 13's merge is a separate instruction I give explicitly.

## Verify
- `git status --short` lists only `HANDOFF.md`, `docs/TODO.md` and the current `Session log/NNN_*/` folder.
- `git diff -- HANDOFF.md docs/TODO.md | grep -Ei "sk_(live|test)_|sb_(secret|publishable)_|eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}|@[a-z0-9-]+\.(com|org|net)"` prints nothing (the literal placeholder `<FOUNDER_EMAIL>` is fine).
- `grep -c "0. Accounts (step 0.1)" HANDOFF.md` → `1`; `grep -c "com.anacast.app" HANDOFF.md` ≥ 1; `grep -c "Founder computer" HANDOFF.md` → `1`; `grep -ci "TODO.md merged\|TODO.md stays" HANDOFF.md` → `1`.
- `git diff -- HANDOFF.md | grep -E "^-.*(Brand palette|Prussian|Deep Navy|Imperial|Bright Marine|Icy Blue|Still open)"` prints nothing (those sections were verified, not edited).

## Finish
Tick step 0.1 in `docs/TODO.md`, write `session_log.md`, commit `docs: record founder accounts and identity decisions (step 0.1)`, push (`git push origin main` unless another branch was named in this session).

Vercel: a team named Anacast exists and is on Pro — or is on Hobby and HANDOFF.md → Environment status says "upgrade to Pro before step 2.5"; the Vercel GitHub App has access to ChurchAppCLD; no project has been imported yet (step 2.5 imports it).
Stripe: the test-mode dashboard loads under your account; live payments are not activated.

HANDOFF.md → Decisions lists display name Anacast, package id `com.anacast.app` and deep-link scheme `anacast`; you verified without editing that the Brand palette table's third column shows the token roles confirmed on 2026-09-08 and that "Still open for the founder" records "no production domain yet — Vercel URL" (nothing was re-decided).

HANDOFF.md → Environment status has an item "0. Accounts (step 0.1)" listing GitHub, Supabase, Vercel (plan), Stripe, Expo (username), Google/Firebase, Play Console, Apple Developer, domain ("none yet — Vercel URL"), Resend and "Founder computer" as done or deferred to a named step.
A password-manager vault for the project exists and no secret has been written into the repo, a Claude Code prompt, or chat.
Two-factor authentication is on for GitHub, Supabase, Vercel and Stripe (and for Expo and Google once those accounts exist).

Your computer has Git, Node 22 (`node -v`), pnpm 10 (`pnpm -v`) and a clone of RadioDinner/ChurchAppCLD in a folder without spaces; `adb devices` lists your Android phone, or HANDOFF says adb waits until step 5.9.

HANDOFF.md → Decisions records your `docs/TODO.md` branch choice: merged into `main` on a named date, or staying on `claude/project-status-todo-plan-leghlm` with every session starting "Work on branch … for this session." until you say merge.
docs/TODO.md step 0.1 is ticked and pushed (by you or by the helper prompt).

reads: HANDOFF.md — Environment status, Decisions, Still open for the founder, Brand palette
docs/DESIGN.md §13 risks 4–7 (Supabase Free plan, Expo push prerequisites, Vercel Hobby limits, default SMTP)

Orchestrator decisions 5, 17, 18, 31a, 32b and 32c (identity, palette, package id, no domain yet, token roles confirmed, no merge to main until the founder says so) as recorded in HANDOFF.md
steps.notes: Founder-only step; the helper prompt is optional and only edits HANDOFF.md. Costs to expect: Vercel Pro US$20/member/month (recommended now, mandatory before step 2.5 — the checklist allows Hobby today with a recorded upgrade to-do; G6 2.5's precondition sentence 'the Vercel team Anacast is on Pro (step 0.1)' should read 'on Pro (step 0.1, or upgrade now)'), Google Play Console US$25 one-time (needed for steps 6.5/6.8; new personal accounts face a 14-day closed test, so create it by 4.5), Apple Developer US$99/year (step 6.4), everything else free in test/Free tiers. Supabase Free consequences (50 MB upload cap, 1 GB storage, 500 MB DB, 5 GB egress, pause after 7 idle days) bite in 2.4/2.5, not here. The identity values are no longer decisions: package id `com.anacast.app` (decision 18), scheme `anacast` (decision 5), palette (decision 17), token roles (decision 32b, confirmed 2026-09-08) and "no production domain yet — Vercel URL" (decision 31a) are all settled and HANDOFF's "Still open for the founder" reads "Nothing … do not re-ask"; items 9.4/9.5, the helper and done_when only verify them (global founder review, 2026-09-15). Items 12–14 were added on 2026-09-15 from the global review: item 12 "Your computer" (Git, Node 22, pnpm 10, clone, adb for 5.9; Expo/Google/Apple logins are interactive and cannot be done by an agent) is the reference that 2.5 item 1, 4.5 item 4 and 5.9's intro should cite — propagation for G6/G11/G13; item 13 makes the founder choose between merging `claude/project-status-todo-plan-leghlm` into `main` (decision 32c: only when the founder says so) and naming the branch every session, because every agent prompt ticks `docs/TODO.md`, which is not on `main` until then; item 14 ticks the step. Item 8 now says the app URL needs no domain (decision 31a) but e-mail does before 3.9 item 5 (G10's propagation request). The founder's real email is known to the orchestrator but the TODO uses `<FOUNDER_EMAIL>` on purpose: prompt_history.txt is committed verbatim, so nothing personal or secret should be typed into prompts. Revised 2026-09-08 from the three critic reviews and 2026-09-15 from the global review (package id and palette aligned with decisions 17/18, Vercel GitHub App click path, 2FA sub-items, Expo username, Play Console and Apple Developer accounts, domain consequences, executable Verify).

steps.title: Monorepo scaffold
steps.goal: The repository becomes a working pnpm 10 + Turborepo 2 workspace with three empty but lint/typecheck/test-clean TypeScript packages (`@church/domain`, `@church/db`, `@church/supabase-client`), shared `@church/tsconfig` and `@church/eslint-config` tooling packages, root config (package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml with hoisted linker + onlyBuiltDependencies + catalog, turbo.json, tsconfig.base.json, .nvmrc, prettier, editorconfig, .env.example), a committed lockfile, a non-blocking GitHub Actions workflow whose later-phase steps are file-guarded and fully written (Postgres 16 service with `PG_SUPER_URL`, `pnpm --filter web build`, expo checks, types drift with `DATABASE_URL`), `apps/web/vercel.json` with the Pro `*/5 * * * *` cron, `docs/ENV.md` covering every environment variable including `NEXT_PUBLIC_MAX_UPLOAD_MB` plus the Vercel project settings step 2.5 enters, and an updated README. `pnpm install && pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` is green from a fresh clone; no app code, migrations, Next.js or Expo yet.
